
==== description_110 : [[jbocre: LA_499]] [[jbocre: sumti_tail_111]] [[jbocre: gap_450]]  [[jbocre: LE_488 sumti_tail_111]] [[jbocre: gap_450]] ; ====

This phrase may be an entire sumti of its own, of the kind "le cmavo",

or "la tsali". It is referenced, with many layers of indirection, from

[[jbocre: sumti_90]].

A "sumti tail" is almost the same as a [[bridi tail|bridi tail]], except that there are

many additional possible phrases that can only occur inside a

description.

[[jbocre: gap_450]] is essentially a slot for the [[elidable terminator|elidable terminator]] [[jbocre: KU|KU]].

Note that this rule covers all gadri. LO-series is a part of selma'o [[jbocre: LE|LE]].
